answer: Coordinated-Delay Seeding. Each new identity must anchor to an existing trellis of agents and wait out a join delay that lengthens with how many identities share the same funding source or timing window. Only at the network's activity zenith can a cohort's full voting weight activate, so mass registration stalls. Attacker cost is the real idle capital and lost throughput across every fake identity, which scales faster than the identities gained, and the garden of honest agents keeps growing while fakes wait.
